page_title: NAP 1-0 ROM | Napoli v AS Roma 24/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+3' Great solo effort from David Neres (Napoli)! He beat a couple of players and shot from the edge of the box, but the effort slips just wide of the left post.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Davide Massa didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
90' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) plays a through ball but overhits it.
88' Substitution. Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Gianluca Mancini walks off.
86' Here is a change. Frank Anguissa is going off and Antonio Conte gives the last tactical orders to Michael Folorunsho (Napoli).
86' Here comes a substitution. Matteo Politano is given a rest as he is replaced by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli).
84' Angelino (AS Roma) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
84' Mats Hummels (AS Roma) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
83' Angelino (AS Roma) is about to take a corner kick.
83' A pass into the penalty area from Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) is intercepted by the defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AS Roma.
79' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) replacing Romelu Lukaku.
78' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Niccolo Pisilli and he is replaced by Samuel Dahl (AS Roma).
78' Substitution. Saud Abdulhamid (AS Roma) on for Zeki Celik.
77' AS Roma keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
76' Matteo Politano (Napoli) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
71' David Neres (Napoli) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
67' Today's match ends for Khvicha Kvaratskhelia who will be replaced by David Neres (Napoli).

66' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His almost perfect header hits the bar and ricochets away off it. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
66' Angelino (AS Roma) will take the free kick.
65' Scott McTominay (Napoli) commits a rough foul. Davide Massa stops the game and makes a call.

64' AS Roma slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
60' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) for his blatant foul.
58' Tommaso Baldanzi (AS Roma) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
54' 1 - 0 Goal Romelu Lukaku (Napoli)! Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) was put through by Giovanni Di Lorenzo and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 1:0.
52' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) finds his way to a cross and strikes towards the goal, but one of the defending players deflects the ball away.
51' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) latches on to a cross to head the ball wide of the net. A poor header.
50' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

50' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
50' Napoli keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is replaced by Tommaso Baldanzi.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Ranieri gives a chance to Mats Hummels and Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is off.
46' Referee Davide Massa blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
44' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post.
44' Corner kick. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is ready to send the ball into the box.
43' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
43' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
40' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick!
40' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
38' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Davide Massa had an easy-decision to make.
37' Matteo Politano (Napoli) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.

36' Matteo Politano (Napoli) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.
34' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
33' Matteo Politano (Napoli) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mile Svilar, who smothers the ball.
29' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
28' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
28' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
27' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Napoli will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
26' Mile Svilar pulls off a great save to deny Scott McTominay (Napoli), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
24' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

24' This shall not pass! Scott McTominay (Napoli) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.

23' Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Alex Meret has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
19' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
18' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
18' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.
16' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Mile Svilar comes off his line to gather the ball.
16' Wonderful movement by Napoli. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
15' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) brings his opponent down. Davide Massa has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
14' Davide Massa blows the whistle, Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is penalised for a foul.
10' Scott McTominay (Napoli) connects with a loose ball in the box, but sends his first-time shot miles past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli).
5' Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
4' AS Roma are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
3' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but powers his header just wide of the left post.
1' The match has just started.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Davide Massa is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
